authority_note: This extension records current CrownThrive system identities and bounded responsibilities. Registration does not manufacture economic, legal, sanctions, provider, merge, closure, or governance authority.

systems.purpose: Mandatory CrownThrive Commerce & Economic Activation Authority and CHLOM cross-pallet commerce/economic-execution subprotocol, including governed economic state, reconciliation, credits, SKUs, settlement, entitlements, pricing, catalog, checkout, receipts, compensation, policy and provider bridges.
systems.authority_boundary: PentaGreen may optimize within authority. It may never manufacture authority; provider success does not independently create economic truth, entitlement, settlement, payout, pricing, licensing, or D3 authority.

five_stage.discover: Resolve economic intent, catalog/SKU state, balances, provider evidence, entitlements and obligations.
five_stage.govern: Apply CHLOM authority, ECAC/HOLD/DENY policy, limits, quorum, rights, finance, legal and security boundaries.
five_stage.execute: Perform only bounded economic activation through certified provider routes and compatibility runtime paths.
five_stage.verify: Reconcile provider evidence before accepting institutional economic truth.
five_stage.preserve: Retain ledgers, receipts, SKUs, aliases, reversals, settlement evidence, policy versions and provenance.

systems.purpose: Phase 3 sanctions-data monitoring and evidence subsystem consuming official OFAC data feeds, validating source integrity, fingerprinting changes and preserving operational evidence for downstream governed compliance decisions.
systems.authority_boundary: A sanctions-feed observation is a compliance signal, not independent authority to block funds, reject a counterparty, or declare a person/entity sanctioned; downstream action remains separately governed by CHLOM policy and evidence.

five_stage.discover: Poll and detect authoritative OFAC source changes on governed schedules.
five_stage.govern: Validate source, namespace, integrity, evidence and downstream policy boundaries.
five_stage.execute: Fetch, validate, fingerprint and record bounded sanctions-data observations.
five_stage.verify: Confirm source integrity, hashes, timestamps and runtime evidence.
five_stage.preserve: Retain fingerprints, source lineage, change events and operational evidence.

systems.purpose: Open-PR intake, stack awareness, nurture, persistent deadline tracking and governed disposition into merge, restack, nurture or close lanes.
systems.authority_boundary: PentaPR classifies and records lifecycle state only; a disposition label does not manufacture merge eligibility, authority, review, or deployment permission.

five_stage.discover: Enumerate open PRs and exact-head state.
five_stage.govern: Classify draft, drift, checks, mergeability, supersession and hard deadline state.
five_stage.execute: Persist lifecycle markers and one active disposition label.
five_stage.verify: Re-read exact head, checks and governed merge evidence on later passes.
five_stage.preserve: Retain first-seen/deadline markers, rationale, head SHA and disposition history.

systems.purpose: Exact-head governed PR promotion for PRs that are non-draft, mergeable, free of failed/pending checks and successful on the Governed Merge Gate.
systems.authority_boundary: PentaMerge never force-merges, self-approves, bypasses failed/pending checks, or converts an unqualified PR into an authorized merge.

five_stage.discover: Resolve PRs labeled for merge and their exact current heads.
five_stage.govern: Require mergeability, successful Governed Merge Gate and no failed/pending checks.
five_stage.execute: Perform SHA-bound governed merge through GitHub.
five_stage.verify: Read the provider merge result and terminal PR state.
five_stage.preserve: Retain merge SHA, source head, gate evidence and lifecycle provenance.

systems.purpose: Enforce the 12-hour PR terminal lifecycle by attempting one final governed merge and otherwise closing the PR while preserving branch and Git provenance.
systems.authority_boundary: The hard deadline is a backlog/transport rule, not authority to force-merge; missing evidence terminates safely as CLOSED rather than manufacturing eligibility.

five_stage.discover: Resolve open tracked PRs whose persistent deadline has elapsed.
five_stage.govern: Perform a final exact-head merge-eligibility evaluation.
five_stage.execute: Merge only if qualified; otherwise record rationale and close without deleting history.
five_stage.verify: Confirm terminal provider state MERGED or CLOSED.
five_stage.preserve: Retain rationale, lifecycle marker, branch provenance and terminal disposition evidence.
